Subject: Renewal window coming up — exploring alternatives

Hi Sofia,

Quick note as we enter our renewal window in June. Weve had an internal push to re-evaluate our inference stack: latency at peak and predictable capacity are the two big issues. Theres a procurement-led bakeoff on the calendar and a couple of vendors are proposing an aggressive price/perf ROI.

Can Redwood run a short benchmark against our 95th-percentile workload and provide an updated proposal that includes a capacity uplift option for Q3? Procurement also wants clarity on term flexibility (12 vs 24 months) and any references we can provide for similar scale.

Attached is the RFP excerpt (SLA & usage profile).

Thanks,
Claire

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window coming up — exploring alternatives

Team — forwarding Claires note. TL;DR: theyre being shopped, want a 95th-percentile benchmark and capacity uplift pricing. Procurement pushed for term flexibility.

Proposed save approach:
- Run an expedited benchmark (48 hrs) using our isolated test harness; present p95/p99 and cost/tokens delta vs their incumbent.
- Offer a 3-month capacity uplift addendum (no long-term commit) to cover Q3 peak, plus a guaranteed fallback route to a lower-cost variant if utilization drops.
- Commercial: two clean options: 12m (standard) and 24m (5% credit + lower per-token bands). Include one-time onboarding credit to offset migration effort.
- If theyre still leaning toward competitor, propose a joint bakeoff with clear acceptance criteria and a short executive review at sign-off.

Requests:
- Priyom: can you validate the pricing for the 3-month uplift and draft the 12/24m bands? Include a bumped SLA for p95 latency during uplift and the technical addendum.
- Jonas: can ops own the benchmark plan and confirm what sanitized sample we need? Start with a 10k-seq token trace.
- Marissa: heads up — this is likely a mid-six-figure renewal. Need discretionary credit approval range.

Ill sync with Claire after I hear from you.

Thanks,
Sofia

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal window coming up — exploring alternatives

Sofia — pricing notes:
- 3-month uplift (reserve 4x peak capacity) — list price delta ~$72,500/mo.
- 12-month renewal: baseline + uplift opt-in; effective blended price = baseline * 0.98 (2% credit)
- 24-month renewal: blended price = baseline * 0.93 (7% credit) + one-time onboarding credit up to $25k (applies if signed within 30 days)

If we put the onboarding credit + 7% on the table for 24m Id recommend Marissa pre-approve up to $30k of discretionary credit so closing team can move without delay.

Jonas — benchmark plan ok with me; confirm runtime image and quantization profile we should use (we probably want int8 for representative perf).

Priyom
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
